team.title: Brand team
team.descriptionOwner: Invite the people on your team who follow the campaigns.
team.descriptionStaff: Who from the brand accesses this portal.
team.inviteCreated: Invitation created. Copy the link and send it to the person.

creators.title: Heroes
creators.description: Heroes from {agency} available to your brand.
creators.descriptionNoAgency: Your brand is not linked to an agency yet.
creators.sourceNote: Metrics declared by the hero or the agency, always with the data date. No values: the commercial proposal is made with the agency.
creators.empty: No heroes released to the catalog yet.
creators.emptyHint: The agency releases heroes as each one consents.
creators.unavailableHint: The catalog appears as soon as the database is updated.
creators.availabilityHint: Periods declared by the hero or the agency. The private calendar never shows.
creators.noPeriods: No declared periods. Ask the agency in the proposal.
creators.compareHint: Mark 2 to 4 heroes to compare side by side.
creators.consentNote: Only heroes who agreed to be in the catalog appear, with the data their media kit shares.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Your proposals and the progress of each campaign with the agency.
campaigns.unavailableHint: Campaigns appear as soon as the database is updated.
campaigns.noAgency: Your brand is not linked to an agency yet: proposals can only be sent after the link.
campaigns.emptyHint: Build the first proposal: objective, audience, period, deliverables and offered value.
campaigns.newDescription: Goes to {agency}, which reviews it, consults the heroes and confirms with you. Save as a draft whenever you want.
campaigns.talentsPending: The agency is consulting the heroes. You see the confirmed lineup as soon as the campaign is approved.
campaigns.agencyNote: Values, contracts and the negotiation with heroes stay with the agency.

form.forCreator: Proposal addressed to {name}. The agency may suggest other heroes.
form.title: Campaign name
form.audienceHint: In words: who you want to reach.
form.desiredTimeHint: For an in-person action or a live.
form.locationHint: Address or city, if in person.
form.budgetHint: Optional. Only your brand and the agency admin see it.
form.notesHint: Free briefing: tone, references, what to avoid.
form.incompleteHint: To send: title, objective, start date, one network and one deliverable.
form.confirmHint: The agency receives the briefing and starts consulting the heroes. You follow the progress here and can cancel until there is a confirmation.
form.incomplete: Something is missing: title, objective, start date, one network and one deliverable.
form.briefInvalid: Check the brief: hashtags with #, valid @ handles and https links.
form.budgetAgreedHint: Amount agreed in the sponsorship (can't change here).
form.budgetNegotiatingHint: Sponsorship: the amount comes from the negotiation on the opportunity.

valueErrors.value_per_hero_required: For a per-hero value, enter what each hero receives.
valueErrors.max_heroes_required: For a per-hero value, enter the maximum number of heroes (1 to 50).

groups.quantityHint: Applies to each type on each network.
groups.summary: Creates {count, plural, one {# deliverable} other {# deliverables}}: {kinds} on {networks}
groups.total: In total: {count, plural, one {# deliverable} other {# deliverables}} across {combos, plural, one {# type and network combination} other {# type and network combinations}} (max {max}).
groups.tooMany: That is {count} type and network combinations; the maximum is {max}. Remove some types or networks.
groups.tooManyTotal: Adding up all heroes, the proposal has {count} different type and network combinations; the maximum is {max}.

cancel.title: Cancel this proposal?
cancel.hint: The agency is notified. After confirmation, only the agency can close it.

campaigns.approvalsHint: Approve or request changes on each script. The decision unlocks the recording.

agenda.title: Calendar
agenda.description: Confirmed campaigns, publications and meetings scheduled by {agency}, plus the commercial dates it publishes.
agenda.descriptionNoAgency: Your brand is not linked to an agency yet.
agenda.unavailableHint: The calendar appears as soon as the database is updated.
agenda.emptyHint: When a campaign is confirmed, it shows up here with its publication dates.
agenda.note: Internal production deadlines and the heroes' calendars do not show: only what matters to the brand.

budget.title: Budget
budget.hint: What the brand reserved, what is committed to hired heroes and what was paid.
budget.sourceOffered: Using the maximum told to the agency
budget.committedHint: What the brand pays for hired heroes (fee and service rate not split).
budget.paymentDue: Payment to the agency expected by {date}
budget.amountHint: Blank goes back to what was told to the agency.
budget.ownerOnly: Only the brand owner sets the budget.
budget.overviewHint: Reserved, committed and paid across all sent campaigns.
budget.overviewEmpty: No campaign with budget or hiring yet.
budget.overCount: {count, plural, one {# campaign is over budget} other {# campaigns are over budget}}
budget.talentsOver: {count, plural, one {# hero over budget} other {# heroes over budget}}
budget.lockedHint: A set budget is locked. To change it, use “Request budget change”: the agency reviews it and the owner confirms.
